args.text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Marrow Fieldworks you can find across Moss's notes and #central-random? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Here's every Marrow Fieldworks ticket number I could find in Moss's notes and #central-random:

1. *#4409*: Gatehouse Check-In report keeps timing out at the Salina North yard (Bay 4 and the west grain-bin apron, during the 06:00 flatbed intake). _Source: Moss's digest "Central handoffs next week" (teams/team-central/digests/2026-01-02-central-handoffs.md)._
2. *#4412*: Driver SMS prompt glitch when combine trailers are staged on unpaved overflow lots. _Source: the same Moss digest (2026-01-02)._
3. *#8841*: West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots double-books when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. You flagged this one for support. _Source: your message in #central-random, 13 Oct 09:27._

How I matched them: the digest says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan and lists #4409 and #4412 as open tickets on "Pree's dealer account" before the handoff. In #central-random, Hollis asks about "Tobias's dealer account", which is the thread where #8841 comes up. So I've counted all three as Fieldworks, but none of the sources actually prints the account name next to the ticket number.

I left these out:
• *FR-882* (custom pallet-jack icons). That's a feature request from *Marrow Agrisupply*, a different account. Moss's cheat sheet also has an Agrisupply "door 4 msg" item, but it has no ticket number.
• *#4419* and *#PD-4492*. Both are Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets.
• Pree's Okta/IT ticket in #central-random. It has no number and isn't about Marrow.

I couldn't check the account's own ticket files in the share. If the 2026-01-02 digest is the latest, #4409 and #4412 were last shown as open back in January, so it's worth checking whether they're still open before your call.
